Who I Am

About.

I'm a developer who enjoys building things that feel purposeful and polished. My work spans civic platforms, fintech simulators, and peer-to-peer tools — all built with a focus on clean UI and solid logic.

I've also served as a speaker at DMCE workshops, sharing insights on Backend Development and helping participants grow from novices to confident engineers.

When I'm not coding, I'm thinking about design systems, UX patterns, and how to make interfaces that people actually want to use.
